answer: Sybil resistance comes from staked identity: before an agent may cast a signed vote it must lock real collateral, so every fake account still needs capital behind it. An attacker cannot mint influence for free by splitting one orchard stake into a thousand wallets, because the locked sum is unchanged. If two wallets sign conflicting attestations, the jade stake is slashed and burned, so deceit forfeits the bond outright. With only a quill of a budget, a Sybil farmer can spawn countless addresses but never the stake behind them.
